description: Canonical capability vocabulary for the sigil:media_buyer:v1 profile. An AIT's `capabilities` array MUST draw only from these tokens. The witness rejects an AIT declaring a capability outside this set.

capabilities.bid:submit: Submit a bid into an exchange auction.
capabilities.bid:read_response: Read the auction response (won / lost / clearing price).
capabilities.supply:verify_via_sigil: Call Sigil supply-path verification before bidding.
capabilities.budget:decrement: Decrement campaign budget on a won impression.
capabilities.creative:select: Select which creative to attach to a bid.
capabilities.report:export_receipt: Request an ATAP compliance receipt for a period.
